{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Breakfast Recipes|Breakfast Recipes]]

A deliciously sweet [[Cookbook:Muffin|muffin]] recipe that makes an excellent [[Cookbook:Breakfast Recipes|breakfast]].

==Ingredients==
* 1 ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (250 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 8.8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Flour|all-purpose flour]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (80 g / 2.8 oz) [[Cookbook:Chocolate chips|chocolate chips]]
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (175 g / 6.2 oz) [[Cookbook:Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* ⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (40 g / 1.4 oz) [[Cookbook:Cocoa|cocoa]], [[Cookbook:Sifting|sifted]] if lumpy
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (250 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 8.5 oz) [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* ⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (80 ml / 2.7 fl oz) [[Cookbook:Oil|cooking oil]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]

==Procedure==
#Combine all-purpose flour, chocolate chips, sugar, cocoa, salt, and baking powder in a [[Cookbook:Mixing Bowl|mixing bowl]]. Create a well in the center.
#Beat egg in a small bowl. Add milk, cooking oil, and vanilla. Stir and pour into well. Stir until just moistened.
#Grease 12 [[Cookbook:Muffin Pan|muffin cups]] with cooking spray. Fill cups ¾ full.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|400°F]] (205°C) for 20 minutes until a [[Cookbook:Skewer|skewer]] inserted into the center tests clean.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*These taste best when still warm.
*If you don't have cooking spray, use [[Cookbook:Cupcake Liner|paper liners]].
*Try adding white chocolate shavings on top, or even white chocolate chips.
